The night snack bar is one of the best places in the city. The weather was snowy that day. Last Wednesday, Grace and Mia went to the night snack bar. She spread butter on the toast.
Life is full of small surprises. Grace plays baseball with Mia every Wednesday. Grace spent the weekend at the library. For example, she took a secretarial job at the hospital.
Grace learned a lot about science. They took many photos at the family kitchen. Grace usually has fish for breakfast. In fact, cheese is my favourite pizza topping.
Both of them like fish and tea. Grace hopes to visit Toronto one day. It takes twenty minutes to get to the night snack bar by bike.
